texts: On day 47 of Year 1, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
Sailsworn reported to the Council that the salt-bloom store held fourteen weeks of winter supply.
The Council issued the standard winter feather ration to the Stilllight Station.
Bevin Coombe reported to the Council that no wraith had approached the Stilllight Lantern.
Tessa Brae reported to the Council that the feather store held eight weeks of supply.
The Council issued extra ground feathers to the Stilllight Station for the coming month.
The Council issued extra ground feathers to the two stations nearest the Sunken Cove for the coming month.

q1_issues.issue: "for the coming month" names the period the ration covers, not when the issuing happened, so (Time sk_issue_2 next_month) places a Past event in a future month.

Same misplacement on the second issuing — (Time sk_issue_3 next_month) contradicts (Past sk_issue_3) — and the narrative-relative "the coming month" is rendered as the speech-anchored deictic constant next_month rather than resolved against the discourse time.
The superlative in "the two stations nearest the Sunken Cove" is dropped: (Near sk_stations_1 sunken_cove) says only that the stations are near the cove, which widens the restriction the text states.

q2_gaps: superlative with a comparison landmark ("the two stations nearest the Sunken Cove") — Most / AmongMost take a comparison-CLASS slot and have no slot for the entity compared against, so a landmark superlative has no licensed form

a coverage-period / temporal-extent "for <time span>" adjunct on an event ("issued ... for the coming month") — Beneficiary is benefit-only, Time asserts the event's own time, and no head is designated for the period an action's effect covers

measure-of NP ("fourteen weeks of winter supply", "eight weeks of supply") — Possessive / genitive NP explicitly excludes a measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") but no positive encoding is supplied in its place

additive-quantity modifier "extra" ("extra ground feathers") — not a fusing classifier and not one of the excessive / insufficient / sufficient quantity markers, so the descriptive-modifier route ends up asserting of each individual feather that it is `extra`
review.notes: The rest checks out: Bevin Coombe's wholly-negative complement is correctly dropped with the attitude event left Theme-less, and seal projection (definite typing plus compound genus atoms, indefinite witnesses kept inside) follows the interim table. Near is licensed as an entity-attached surface-preposition oblique, but it rides the group symbol rather than distributing to the member stations.

issues.reason: Time attaches an event's OWN time, so (Time sk_issue_2 next_month) asserts the issuing happened in the coming month while (Past sk_issue_2) and the passage's 'day 47 of Year 1' place it then - a false atom, since 'for the coming month' names the period the ration covers, not when the issuing occurred.

Both halves stand: (Time sk_issue_3 next_month) is the same false event-time atom, and 'the coming month' is narrative-relative to day 47 of Year 1 while 'Deictic times are speech-anchored CONSTANTS' makes next_month anchor to the speech time, so the constant mis-anchors a discourse-relative period that term propagation was supposed to resolve.

'No comparative, approximator or minimizer ever asserts the positive' and 'a stated restriction, hedge or qualifier is never silently dropped' both bite: (Near sk_stations_1 sunken_cove) asserts a positive nearness that 'nearest' does not entail and widens 'the two stations NEAREST the Sunken Cove' to 'two stations near it', and Near is not even the word used.

gaps_confirmed: landmark superlative ('the two stations nearest the Sunken Cove'): Most / AmongMost carry a comparison-CLASS slot and no slot for the entity compared against, so the landmark has no licensed carrier

coverage-period 'for <span>' adjunct on an event ('issued ... for the coming month'): Beneficiary is benefit-only and Time asserts the event's own time; the preposition-named (For <event> ...) oblique is the nearest carrier but is designated for the ground / prize / exchange sense, and no head is named for the period an action's effect covers

measure-of NP ('fourteen weeks of winter supply', 'eight weeks of supply'): Possessive / genitive NP explicitly excludes the measure of-phrase and no section states the positive mapping - the Measure family serves (as this parse used it, with scale 'unspecified') but is never designated for it

additive-quantity modifier 'extra' ('extra ground feathers'): not a fusing classifier and not one of the excessive / insufficient / sufficient quantity markers, so the descriptive-modifier route predicates 'extra' of each individual feather when it is the amount, not the feather, that is additional
new_gaps: a narrative-relative temporal NP whose antecedent supplies no term at that granularity ('the coming month' against a day-of-year calendar, 'day 47 of Year 1'): term propagation has no Month term to increment, and the stated BeforeBy fallback orders two eventualities rather than an event and a period, so nothing licensed names the period

an entity-attached positional oblique on a group symbol ((Near sk_stations_1 sunken_cove)) has no stated distributive counterpart: a position holding of the member stations rides the group-as-object, the same reading the plural rules bar for (Member <group> <prop>)
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: drop (Time sk_issue_2 next_month) - the issuing's only time is day 47 of Year 1, and the coverage period has at best the preposition-named oblique (For sk_issue_2 <period>), otherwise it is left out with the gap recorded. Issue 1: the same for (Time sk_issue_3 next_month); 'the coming month' would need a narrative-relative term (the antecedent's month term plus one) rather than the speech-anchored next_month, and no such term is licensed here because the passage's calendar states no month. Issue 2: the compliant form keeps (GroupOf sk_stations_1 station) and (Cardinality sk_stations_1 2) and leaves the superlative restriction unencoded with the gap recorded, since no Most / AmongMost form carries a landmark and a superlative never licenses its positive.
adjudication.notes: The Bevin Coombe sentence is exactly right - a wholly negative complement dropped, the attitude event left Theme-less, the definite Stilllight Lantern still typed and named. Seal projection elsewhere also matches the interim table: definite store typing and the compound genus atoms sit at top level while the indefinite supply witnesses and their Measure atoms stay inside.
